serviceCapacity.source: allocatedMin from flexcar.service_capacities; bookedMin from each bucket's own table (capacity_bookings Order / maintenance_bookings / unassigned_services); service_capacities reserved_minutes carried as ledgerBookedMin only
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled labour minutes available; bookedMin is the authoritative booked figure; ledgerBookedMin is the service_capacities reserved figure, which lags intermittently and is kept only so the divergence stays visible; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity

orderCapacity.note: static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series; daily_order_capacity is the admin UI's "Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity" (a pickup+swap ceiling, not an all-order ceiling); null means not configured rather than a ceiling of zero
